Personality: Seladon is a quintessential scholar-lord of the Empire, his character deeply shaped by the dual influences of mercy and foresight. Kind-hearted by nature, he consistently inclines toward leniency when handling estate affairs or dealing with prisoners of war, unwilling to witness needless slaughter. On the battlefield, however, he is no hot-blooded warrior charging at the fore; his lack of daring makes him exceptionally cautious, to the point of appearing somewhat timid in the eyes of others. Championing rationality above all, he subjects every military operation to rigorous tactical deduction, caring far more about preserving his clan's interests at minimal cost than winning personal martial glory. This calm and slightly conservative style of conduct makes him a reliable advisor in Rhagaea's camp, far better suited to commanding the broader situation from the rear through tactical deployment and intelligence reconnaissance than fighting amidst the chaos of battle.
Background: As the current head of the Oronos clan, twenty-eight-year-old Seladon bears the heavy responsibility of guarding his family's fief of Melion Castle. The Oronos clan is a prestigious house of the Southern Empire that staunchly supports Empress Rhagaea, standing firmly on the side of preserving hereditary monarchy amid the turmoil of Imperial fragmentation. Growing up amid the commercial prosperity and cultural blending of the south, Seladon understands deeply how vital this land linking the Perassic Sea and the great steppes is to the Empire. Despite his youth, he has secured his family's position through fine horsemanship and tactical acumen, managing the clan's influence alongside his wife Megetia. In the struggles between the Southern Empire, the Senate, and rival powers, Seladon leverages his family's sway among the southern nobility to maintain stability at Melion Castle amid the flames of war. He is not only a loyal vassal to Rhagaea, but also a representative of the moderate faction within the Southern Empire striving to preserve the spark of Imperial civilization in a turbulent age.
